about: Data migration DB 21 -> 22 (docs/ACTIVITY-MODEL.md section 6, 3.1, 5). Every implementation runs these cases: migrate(before, zone) must equal `after` once both are normalized. `before` holds the DB 21 tables `time_entry`, `segment`, `external_ref`, `todo`, `absence`, `work_schedule`, `lunch_break`, `day_off` (a missing table is empty; a missing column is null, except todo.kind = 'TASK', todo.done = 0, todo.refs = '', time_entry.unanswered_reminders = 0, time_entry.needs_review = 0, segment.uid = ''). Booleans are 0/1, times are epoch ms, days epoch days, minutes are minutes of the local day (work_schedule.day_of_week: 1 = Monday). `zone` is the zone for the rows created from a to-do or a legacy absence (the todo table has none). `after` holds `time_entry`, `segment`, `external_ref` (the only tables that change; `todo` and `absence` are gone, the others are untouched) in normal form: no `id`; segment and external_ref rows name their activity by `entry_uid` instead of `entry_id`; columns that are null are omitted; `plugin_fields` is the parsed JSON object; rows sorted by (entry_uid, start_utc_ms, uid, value) - compare as unordered sets. New time_entry columns always present: kind, priority (and status). Old segments get planned = 0. New uids: uuid5(6f1c2a52-6b1e-5a8e-9d7e-0a5c1e7d1000, '<to-do uid>/<suffix>') with suffixes abs/<yyyy-mm-dd>/<n> (n from 0 in the day), ref/<i> (i = index among the to-do's distinct non-blank refs lines), link/<entry uid> (the UUID reference of the other entries). Choices not in the spec are listed in the header of scripts/activity_migration.py (CHOICE).

cases.name: entry ACTIVE with an open WORK segment becomes RUNNING
entry SUSPENDED becomes RUNNING, no mode
entry TO_COMPLETE becomes CLOSED at its last segment end
entry CLOSED without segments closes at its last update
todo without entries, open, with plan, due, key, refs, plugin fields
todo without entries, done
todo without entries, ignored
todo done with one entry: the entry absorbs it (title becomes the description)
todo done with one entry that has its own description, notes and company: the entry wins
todo done with three entries: the earliest by first segment start absorbs, the others get a UUID ref
todo done with three entries, tie on first start: created_utc_ms decides
todo done with three entries, tie on start and created: uid decides
todo open with a running entry (also the earliest): it absorbs the to-do and stays RUNNING; the closed one gets a ref
todo open, the running entry is not the earliest: the earliest (closed) still absorbs, the running one gets the ref
todo done with a running entry: absorbed, stays RUNNING
todo open with all entries closed: it stays its own TODO, each entry gets a UUID ref
todo ignored with entries all closed: stays TODO activity, deleted
entry with a todo_id that matches no to-do is a plain entry
refs text becomes external_ref rows classified URL, UUID, TICKET, OTHER; blank lines and duplicates dropped; the entry's own ref kept once

cases.name: plugin_fields: the entry's values win over the to-do's; null and invalid JSON count as empty
entry without description gets the to-do's title; a blank one counts as none
priorities: null, 1..5, 7, 0, -1 (P1 -> 5 ... P5 -> 1, empty -> 0, above 5 -> 1, below 1 -> 0)
absence to-do, one whole working day with a lunch break: two segments
absence over Thu-Tue across a weekend and a day off: only working days, two segments each
absence without lunch break on that weekday: one segment; days without schedule give none
absence with start and duration (permesso): one segment, the end date is ignored
absence with a start and no duration: a zero-length segment
absence on the spring DST change (Europe/Rome 2026-03-29, 01:00-05:00 on a Sunday schedule is 3 hours)
absence on the autumn DST change (Europe/Rome 2026-10-25, 01:00-05:00 on a Sunday schedule is 5 hours; 02:30 is the first one)
absence kind from the title: the four labels, four languages, case and spaces ignored; anything else is ABSENCE
absence to-do without a plan: the activity stays, with no segment; title blank means no description
legacy absence rows: FULL_DAY, LATE_ENTRY, EARLY_EXIT
legacy absence rows that missed nothing or are unknown are dropped; one on a day off keeps its activity without segment
everything together: ids of new rows follow the old ones
an ignored absence to-do goes to the bin
external_key unique with the company: the earliest created activity keeps it, the others lose it
